entries.content: [NT-PHYSICAL] Clay Safari: Blender Python parametric modeling (20-40 lines/model, 19 models in ~10s) + procedural world gen (value noise terrain, instanced vegetation, vertex-color paint) + zero external assets. MeshPhysicalMaterial sheen for clay feel. Web Audio synthesis for 17 sounds. GLB export with pivot() joint origins.
[NT-PHYSICAL] MuJoCo: DeepMind physics simulation engine. Contact dynamics + joint constraints + GPU acceleration. Standard for robotics sim. Rust bindings available.
[NT-PHYSICAL] ciechanow.ski: interactive physics visualization (fluid/collision) + pedagogical engineering documentation. Sets bar for technical content quality.
